Maharaja Ranjit Singh (1792-1839) He was the greatest Indian ruler
of his time .nd founder of the Sikh rule in the Punjab: Born in 1780 at
Gujranwala, he occupied Lahore in 1799 and made it his capilal: He
conquered Amritsar in 1802, occupied Ludhiana and after incessant
wars, annexed Kangra, Attock Multan; Kashmir; Hazara, Bannu;
Derajat and Peshawar: He died in 1839.
Successors of Ranjit Singh Kharak Singh (1839-40), Naunihal Singh]
